question: The LCM of two numbers is 840 and their HCF is 7 . If one of the numbers is 56 , find the other.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product of numbers = **LCM** × **HCF**

Other number = (840 × 7) ÷ 56

Other number = 840 ÷ 8 = 105

**∴ The correct answer is 105.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6f00a0bed6ad6eebca9c5bd4fdf1b9275b5b08b834827dbc7bba73e5f831d14.png] 

**Given:**

**LCM** = 840

**HCF** = 7

**First Number** (n₁) = 56

**Formula Used:**

n₁ × n₂ = **LCM** × **HCF**

**Calculations:**

⇒ 56 × n₂ = 840 × 7

⇒ n₂ = (840 × 7) ÷ 56

⇒ n₂ = 5880 ÷ 56

⇒ n₂ = 105

**∴ The correct answer is 105.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF and LCM Relation

The product of any two **positive integers** is always equal to the product of their **HCF** and **LCM**.

Co-prime Numbers

For two **co-prime numbers**, the **HCF** is always 1 and the **LCM** is the product of the numbers themselves.

HCF Property

The **HCF** of two or more numbers is always a factor of their **LCM**.</p
